metricDefinitions.iou_foreground: IoU of masks max(255-R,255-G,255-B) > 12 (includes ground shadow)
metricDefinitions.iou_character: IoU of foreground masks minus shadow-classified pixels (|R-220|<=14,|G-219|<=14,|B-222|<=14)
metricDefinitions.palette_exact_pct: rendered pixels exactly equal to one of the 11 locked palette colors
metricDefinitions.palette_near_pct: rendered pixels within +/-2 per channel of a palette color (AA boundary tolerance)

historicalReference.note: Historical 16-sample figures. The original scorer was never committed, so the exact old pct formula cannot be re-derived; METHOD.md described it as "% pixels with delta > 40" at 960x540. These are a reference point only and are NOT comparable 1:1 with the all-frame full-resolution metrics below.

cel94.objective: fidelity deliverable — exact per-frame traced cels

celLoop.objective: comparison/control — 26-cel loop, phase drift EXPECTED, not a fidelity failure

puppet.objective: diagnostic only — objective is editability + plausible motion, NOT pixel equality
